questions.guidance: New mean = (45n + 55)/(n + 1) for large n, approximates 47.

questions.question: What is the coefficient of variation for a data set with a mean of $50$ and a standard deviation of $10$?
questions.guidance: CV = (Standard Deviation / Mean) * 100 = (10 / 50) * 100 = 20%.

questions.question: The 95th percentile of a data set is defined as the value below which 95% of the data falls. If the data set is $[2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10, 12, 15, 20]$, what is the 95th percentile?
questions.guidance: To find the 95th percentile, calculate $0.95 \times (10-1) = 8.55$. Round up to the 9th value, which is $20$.

questions.question: A dataset has the following values: $5, 7, 9, 10, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20$.
questions.guidance: Q1 is the median of the lower half $5,7,9,10$, which is $9$. Q3 is the median of the upper half $12,14,16,18,20$, which is $16$. IQR is $Q3 - Q1 = 16 - 9 = 7$.

questions.question: A box plot displays the following values: minimum $10$, $Q_1=20$, median $30$, $Q_3=40$, maximum $70$. What is the range of the data?
questions.guidance: Range is calculated as maximum - minimum = $70 - 10 = 60$.

questions.question: A data set has a mean of $50$ and a standard deviation of $5$. If a score of $60$ is considered an outlier, what is the corresponding z-score?
questions.guidance: Calculate $z=\frac{x-\bar{x}}{s}=\frac{60-50}{5}=2$.

questions.question: If matrices $A=\begin{bmatrix}1&2\\3&4\end{bmatrix}$ and $B=\begin{bmatrix}5&6\\7&8\end{bmatrix}$, what is the value of $\det(AB)$?
questions.guidance: The determinant of the product of two matrices is the product of their determinants. $\det(A)=1(4)-2(3)=-2$ and $\det(B)=5(8)-6(7)=-2$, thus $\det(AB)=\det(A)\det(B)=(-2)(-2)=4$.

questions.question: In a directed graph with 6 vertices, if every vertex has an out-degree of 3, what is the total number of edges in the graph?
questions.guidance: Each vertex contributes 3 outgoing edges, so total edges = 6 * 3 / 2 = 9. However, since it's directed, total edges = 6 * 3 = 18.

questions.question: For a graph to have an Eulerian circuit, which of the following must be true?
options: All vertices must have even degree.
Exactly two vertices must have odd degree.
The graph must be connected and acyclic.
The graph must have at least one vertex of odd degree.
questions.guidance: An Eulerian circuit exists only if every vertex has an even degree.

questions.question: In a bipartite graph with partitions $X$ and $Y$, where $|X|=4$ and $|Y|=5$, which of the following statements is true?
options: The maximum matching can have at most 4 edges.
The maximum matching can have at most 5 edges.
There can be no perfect matching.
questions.guidance: In a bipartite graph, the maximum matching cannot exceed the size of the smaller partition, which is $|X|=4$.

questions.question: In a directed graph with 6 vertices, where every vertex has an out-degree of 3, how many edges does the graph have?

questions.question: In a graph, if the degree of vertex A is 5, and the degree of vertex B is 3, what can be concluded about the edges connecting A and B?
options: There is 1 edge connecting A and B.
There are at most 5 edges connecting A and B.
There can be no edges connecting A and B.
There are exactly 8 edges connecting A and B.
questions.guidance: The maximum number of edges between two vertices A and B in a simple graph is the minimum of their degrees, which in this case is 3.
